subject: Instrumentation & evals — discovery recap and checklist
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Dr. Anya Patel <anya@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-21T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Instrumentation & evals — discovery recap and checklist

Hi Anya,

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery on NovaMed's pilot focusing on clinical QA and triage assist:

Pain points:
- Low signal on model regressions: you mentioned false positives creeping into triage suggestions after weekly model updates.
- Lack of standard dashboards for prompt-level quality and regression alerts across environments (staging vs prod).
- Instrumentation gaps: tracing hooks not consistently captured for third-party prompt transformations and pre/post processors.

Current stack:
- Models: in-house distilled LLMs + occasional hosted vendor models (fed through a gateway).
- Logging: Splunk for app logs; limited token-level telemetry persisted to S3 (ad hoc schemas).
- CI: nightly model retrain + weekly rollout; manual smoke tests only.

Success criteria (what would make this pilot successful):
1) Detect regressions within 24 hours of a model push with a false-positive reduction target of 30% over 3 months.
2) Prometheus/Grafana dashboards with token-level and prompt-class breakdowns for prod/staging.
3) Tracing hooks that connect an output back to prompt variants + upstream preprocessing for root-cause analysis.

Requested deliverables from Redwood (next steps):
- Instrumentation checklist (what to log, sampling strategy, KV cache markers) — attached (redwood-instrumentation-checklist.xlsx)
- Example dashboard wireframes (prometheus/grafana JSON snippets) — will link after internal review
- Golden prompt sets and evaluation harness proposal (candidate prompts, expected outputs, scoring) — attached (nova_golden_prompts_v1.csv)

Security/compliance notes:
- You flagged SOC 2 evidence for data retention and access controls — Dylan to lead and follow up with the SOC 2 packet.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1 (Nov 29): Share instrumentation checklist + golden prompts
- Week 2 (Dec 6): Onsite/integrated run of eval harness against staging
- Week 4 (Dec 20): Regression alerting configured + dashboard pass

Can you confirm those deliverables and the timeline? If anything above is incomplete or inaccurate, reply with edits.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference

Subject: Re: Instrumentation & evals — discovery recap and checklist

Thanks Vivek — helpful summary.

A few clarifications:
- The false positives you listed are mostly in the 'cardiology triage' prompt family; happy to share an export of recent cases (will send separately to Dylan).
- For dashboards, Grafana is preferred; our SREs use Prometheus for metrics, but we also ingest traces into Honeycomb.
- SOC 2: our security team requires KMS-backed log encryption and proof of role-based access for logs — can your SOC packet specifically call that out?

Two asks before we lock the timeline:
1) Can Redwood provide a short example Grafana panel JSON showing prompt-class histograms and latency by model variant?
2) Can we get a lightweight eval run against a 500‑prompt golden set in staging by Dec 6? (We have a staging mirror with similar traffic.)

We'd like to loop in procurement after we see the sample dashboard and a small eval run. Looking forward to the checklist and the golden prompts — thanks.

—Anya
Dr. Anya Patel
Head of AI Platform | NovaMed
anya@novamed.com

2) Eval run: we can run a 500-prompt pass in staging on Dec 4 (gives us a 48-hour window to validate results before your Dec 6 checkpoint). Timeline updated below.
3) SOC 2 packet: Dylan will add explicit KMS/backed encryption statements and RBAC screenshots in our next note to you.

Updated timeline:
- Nov 26: Grafana panel + README (link below)

Mutual action plan (short):
